$schema: FLAT simple-CRUD module spec — consumed by `npm run module:make -- <spec.json>`
_lifespan_note: REQUIRED in spirit, 'module' in practice. Declare it. 'module' opts into the full ceremony (Data, FilterData, ownership, 401/403/422, bulk pair). 'one-shot' is REFUSED by the generator with guidance: an Artisan command, a migration or a seeder is not a module, and giving it a module's ceremony is the speculative build YAGNI forbids. See PRINCIPLES/SKILL.md §6.
_exports_note: csv | xlsx | pdf. All three are served by Shared\Domain\Ports\ExportPort — the module only ships Exports/{Entity}ExportTransformer.php (columns + lazy owner-scoped rows) plus a thin controller. `pdf` also writes resources/views/exports/{table}.blade.php. An unknown format is a hard error.
_foreign_example: For a FK add { "name": "category_id", "type": "foreign", "references": "categories", "nullable": true } — the referenced table MUST already exist (migration order), else inserts fail.
